title: SEMI’s supply chain survey saw the memory shortage four months early. Now it’s quarterly.
text:
M

Mrinal.beebolt
New member

Hi all,

Full disclosure: I work at Beebolt, which runs Conductor with SEMI. Conductor is a collective intelligence platform for the semiconductor industry, helping companies make better-informed decisions through shared industry insights.

SEMI's Semiconductor Supply Chain Survey picked up the memory shortage in June 2025, four months before it became mainstream news. But an annual survey means waiting a year for the next signal, and that's the feedback we kept hearing from the industry.

So SEMI has launched the Quarterly Pulse Survey: a 3-minute survey on lead times, supply agreements and inventory, designed to see the next shortage before the market does.

Tell us your lead times, get everyone else's. Answers stay private, and everyone who takes part receives the aggregated Q4 results on 24 November. The survey closes on Friday 20 November.

Survey link: https://conductor.beebolt.com/surveys/pulse/dbd882dc-1029-4627-b5d6-bf519eb9a30b
More from SEMI: https://www.semi.org/en/industry-groups/supply-chain-management-survey

I'd love to hear from the community too: where are you seeing lead times move this quarter?

Thanks,
Mrinal
Product Strategy Manager, Beebolt UK
